## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates. It starts at Al Reem Street.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Enter the frosty kingdom of Snow Abu Dhabi to cool down in the Arabian Desert. Explore the Snowflake Garden, full of delicate ice sculptures, or stroll through frosted trees in the Enchanted Forest.
>
> Take part in a playful snowball fight with the kids and send them down the snow tubing track for an icy rush. Then, warm up with a steamy beverage as you soak in the serene splendor of the wintery surroundings of Snow Abu Dhabi.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €56.08. It was rated 3.5 out of 5 from 8 ratings and 2 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
